faq.q: How much does Spodek Law Group charge?
faq.a: Spodek Law Group publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Spodek Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Spodek Law Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Spodek Law Group have offices?
faq.a: Spodek Law Group publishes two offices, in Manhattan and Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Spodek Law Group?
faq.a: Spodek Law Group names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 1 of 3 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: Are the case results Spodek Law Group publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Spodek Law Group publishes five case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Spodek Law Group?
faq.a: Spodek Law Group scores 66 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
